series.title: The Gold Thread of Silence
series.subtitle: Fractured Cynicism
series.tagline: Some break under silence. She wove hers into a weapon.
series.synopsis: Evaluating a mute asylum inmate whose intricate gold-thread embroidery conceals a coded ledger of systemic abuse, forensic textile restorer Ishaan Roy discovers her silent tapestry holds the secret map to his own forgotten childhood.
